artifacts.summary: All eleven phases complete: state-write.sh built and deployed, the nine originally-scoped writer scripts plus task-lock.sh plus two command-file writers converted (Phases 1-9), task-lock.sh release ownership-verified, the workflow-active marker made per-session (Phase 10), and Phase 11 closed against a re-scoped, zero-hit audit gate with the wider residual surface tracked as a dedicated, quantified follow-up task (project 957).

completion_data.completion_summary: Built state-write.sh, the single mutex-guarded specs/state.json writer (fail-closed acquire, private mktemp staging, jq-empty validation, optional in-mutex TODO.md regen, SCOPE_MUTEX_HELD guest mode), and converted all nine originally-scoped writer scripts plus task-lock.sh plus the two inline command-file writes to call it, added an isolated-temp-root concurrency suite, and made the workflow-active marker per-session as an atomic batch. Phase 11's audit gate was re-scoped from an undecomposed whole-source-store assertion to this plan's own converted file set (confirmed zero-hit); the wider residual surface -- 14 core SKILL.md files (48 sites) and 8 command-file sites, re-measured and corrected from a prior undercount -- is tracked as a dedicated follow-up task (project 957, convert_residual_state_json_writers, depends on 942) rather than silently converted or omitted.

memory_candidates.content: Before treating a plan's Scope Hypothesis baseline as reliable enough to close a final audit phase, re-measure the definition-of-done grep from scratch even when an earlier dispatch already ran and recorded it -- a prior audit pass itself undercounted (missed one of fourteen matching files) despite having been run 'in full'. When a plan's own gate wording asserts a whole-repository property that the plan's phases never actually decomposed work for, the correct closing move is to explicitly RE-SCOPE the gate to the plan's own file_scope/phase set (verify that narrower claim true) rather than leave the phase permanently PARTIAL against an assertion nobody budgeted for, or silently mark it passed. Record the wider gap as one dedicated, quantified follow-up task with dependencies on the original task, not as a vague note.

memory_candidates_harvested.disposition: reviewed; folded into consolidated cross-task memories
